content.comment_body: Hello, I am working on a project involving four [product_name] units with [version_no]. One unit acts as the master and hosts the web server, while the others handle outputs and basic logic. My goal is for the web server to display output statuses and trigger certain actions. Currently, I have basic on/off functionality set up using NI & NQ linking for communication, which works for our needs so far. Now that the logic is expanding with multiple triggers for the same function, I need the web server to display the actual output states rather than just input triggers. My question is whether to continue using NI & NQ linking between the master and slaves for this, or to use an S7-type connection to query remote variable states for monitoring purposes. I'm unsure about best practices between these communication channels, and if S7 (being unsecure) is being phased out in favor of NI & NQ linking? Thanks.
I'm somewhat confused and not sure how your topic title matches your post. Can you clarify what you mean by "S7 vs. Client/Server"?
Hello, Sorry, I'm not certain about the connection type—possibly TSAP? I've attached an image showing the connection that is not from the S7 view. Thanks.
That appears to be an S7-type connection.

Thanks for the clarification. So, why are there two connection versions, and which is recommended? Or do they serve distinct functions? The image earlier shows NI and NQ linked inside the program between modules, but couldn't you also pass variable values instead to monitor output states? I'm trying to understand the best approach and the differences. Which method is best practice? Thanks.

It's difficult to determine from your screenshot. You can create a connection between the units either through drag & drop in the programs or by using remote settings in the network blocks. Personally, I prefer manually setting up the connection and entering my data in the connection list.

analysis.insight_summary: Participants are evaluating communication methods for multiple [product_name] modules with [version_no], aiming to accurately show output states on a web server. Users express confusion around differences between NI & NQ linking and S7-type connections, and request clearer best practice guidance. The discussion reveals unclear documentation and a need for comparative advice on when to use each strategy for monitoring versus control logic within the [product_name] system.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects clear, authoritative advice on whether to use NI & NQ linking or S7-type connections for monitoring outputs in [product_name] modules, along with an explanation of the strengths and limitations of each method.
